elements.description: An agent workflow by phase: steps you add, remove, reorder and set up, review gates, versions and a dry run.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The playbook: its steps, in order within each phase. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: phases
properties.default: [ { id: "trigger", label: "Trigger", description: "What starts a run", defaultType: "event" }, { id: "intake", label: "Intake", description: "What comes in, and how it's checked", defaultType: "tool" }, { id: "context", label: "Context", description: "What the agent looks up first", defaultType: "retrieve" }, { id: "analysis", label: "Analysis", description: "What the agent works out", defaultType: "agent" }, { id: "review", label: "Review", description: "Who signs off before anything leaves", defaultType: "review" }, ]
properties.description: The phases, in order – the board's columns

properties.name: stepTypes
properties.default: [ { id: "event", label: "When an event happens", phases: ["trigger"] }, { id: "schedule", label: "On a schedule", phases: ["trigger"] }, { id: "manual", label: "Started by hand", phases: ["trigger"] }, { id: "agent", label: "Agent task" }, { id: "tool", label: "Tool call" }, { id: "retrieve", label: "Look up sources" }, { id: "review", label: "Human review", review: true }, ]
properties.description: The kinds of step people can add

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The id of the step being set up. Picks apply unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: Names the playbook, shown at the top

properties.name: currentVersion
properties.description: The id of the version the board shows

properties.name: dryRun
properties.description: The app's answer to the last tc-dry-run: which steps run, are skipped or pause; null clears it

properties.name: gateConditions
properties.description: Conditions offered by review steps' gates; unset: the gate's defaults

properties.name: gateReviewers
properties.description: Reviewers offered by review steps' gates; unset: the gate's defaults

properties.name: gateViews
properties.description: What a reviewer can see, offered by review steps' gates; unset: the gate's defaults

properties.name: gateActions
properties.description: Actions offered by review steps' gates; unset: the gate's defaults

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The playbook changed: a step added, removed, moved or edited ({ value: Playbook }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A step was picked, or the pick cleared ({ selected: string | null, step?: PlaybookStep }); cancelable

events.name: tc-dry-run
events.description: "Dry run" was pressed ({ value: Playbook }) – answer by setting `dryRun`

events.name: tc-dry-run-clear
events.description: The dry run's result was cleared ({})

events.name: tc-version-open
events.description: "Open" was pressed on a version that isn't current ({ id: string })

props.name: title
props.description: Shown at the top; names the playbook

props.name: stepTypes
props.description: The kinds of step people can add; icons may be React nodes

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The playbook to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole playbook after every add, remove, move or edit

props.name: selected
props.description: The id of the step being set up (controlled); null for none

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The step to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called when a step is picked, or the pick cleared

props.name: onDryRun
props.description: "Dry run" was pressed – answer by setting `dryRun`

props.name: onDryRunClear
props.description: The dry run's result was cleared – set `dryRun` to null

props.name: onVersionOpen
props.description: "Open" was pressed on a version that isn't current

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.
